description: This file contains the PHP class 'Coupon' which extends the base Controller class. It defines methods for handling coupon-related actions in the OpenCart system, including displaying the coupon form ('index') and saving coupon data ('save'). The class interacts with session data, models, and views to manage coupons during the checkout process.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Controller class for handling coupon-related actions within the total extension of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the coupon form page if the coupon total is enabled. Retrieves existing coupon from session and prepares data for the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to save a coupon code. Validates the coupon, updates session data, and returns JSON response indicating success or error.
